messages:
maria_ng: Short post-mortem of today's quick canary: speculative commit + q4-lite on ember-13b. big tail improvement but a tiny cluster of slot-flip regressions. saving notes here.
alex_ryan: drop the numbers when you have them (rough ok).
maria_ng: quick table we exported:
```csv
variant,p50_ms,p95_ms,slot_flip_pct
baseline,128,360,0.5
spec+q4lite,92,245,1.8
spec-only,98,260,0.7
q4lite-only,120,330,1.1
```
samuel: pattern looks like single-token suffix flips in templated fills. most are punctuation or determiners.
jin-ml: likely mechanism: quant slightly shifts softmax margins; speculative commit picks lower-margin tokens earlier and freezes them. need per-token top2-gap at commit.
casey_eval: add both BLEU and exact-match for templated suite; BLEU hides one-token errors. also propose token-flip-rate (fp32 vs quant).
maria_ng: action items: 1) instrument top1/top2 gaps at commit and after quant kernel 2) run three short holdouts bucketed by prompt length & type (templated-short, templated-long, conv) 3) sweep spec.threshold in [0.45,0.6,0.8] and try q8-emul as mid-point 4) add 300-case adversarial templated set (punctuation/casing variants) 5) scrub logs to token ids + numeric diffs only.
ops-bot: Job created: spec-commit-variance-330999 (12 shards).
alex_ryan: also keep RNG fixed across variants to isolate quant noise.
samuel: i'll prototype the histogram exporter for top2 gaps and flip-rate. will tag @casey_eval for metric checks.
maria_ng: thanks all, will post sanitized summaries and decision recommendation after holdouts finish.
